_comment: Copy to backend/mcp.json and edit the paths. mcp.json is gitignored. ${KEEPER_ROOT} expands to the app root, so one config works on the host AND in the container. The manager applies a read-only filter by default; 'tools' is an explicit allowlist (only these pass), 'deny' blocks by name, and 'required' names the tools this server MUST provide - if one is missing the server shows as degraded in /state and on the dashboard instead of quietly going absent. uvx servers pin 'mcp<2' because the published fetch/time/git servers target the mcp 1.x API while the client uses mcp 2.x.
_watch_comment: Tools the proactive loop polls for what is NEW, scored against memory like any feed item. Only tools whose entries carry their own identity belong here (a commit log, a listing, a calendar); a web search returns the same results every time and would have the Keeper announce old news as a discovery. See sources.py.
